svg.title: Sequence Diagram, Module 5: profile, letter completion, stars, streak and unlock (FR-06, FR-08, FR-09, FR-14)

g.text: Sequence Diagram, Module 5: profile, letter completion, stars, streak and unlock (FR-06, FR-08, FR-09, FR-14)
Pick a profile (up to 6, avatar only)
so each child's data stays separate (FR-14)
3 if no heart lost, 2 if up to 2, else 1
same day: keep; next day: +1; gap of 2+ days: 1
play fanfare, complete line, unlock chime, next cue
letter 1 always; else previous letter completed
compare with the last unlocked set
unlock moment: scroll to S, pop, chime,
nodeTapAction(...) = LAUNCH -> Hear It starts (no pop-up)
